note: Downloads go through the API asset endpoint rather than the browser URL, because that is the one that works on a private repository with a token in GITHUB_TOKEN. On a public repository neither needs authentication. scripts/fetch_model.py verifies every digest and refuses a mismatch. The detector is YOLOX-Tiny, Apache-2.0; v0.1.0 holds the earlier YOLOv8n artefacts and is not used.
